render: For each worker profile, emit dist/opencode/agents/agenticale/<name>.md carrying the profile's `mode`, `steps`, and `permissions` frontmatter plus the matching neutral task-contract body copied from skills/work/references/tasks/<role>.md (implement, implement-easy, and implement-hard all use implement.md; consult and consult-hard both use consult.md). The model for that role is taken from the flat model config at build time (`adapters/opencode/models.json` by default, or the `--models` option): a listed role writes one `model:` line in `provider/model[#variant]` form into the rendered profile frontmatter, while an unlisted role omits the `model:` line so the profile inherits the session model. The seven base roles always render, one profile per role; the optional implement-easy and consult-hard profiles render only when the config lists them explicitly, so their harder/easier dispatch context is not silently dropped. When the config carries the top-level coordinator key, the build additionally emits the primary coordinator profile from the `coordinator` entry below (body copied from the adapter-owned coordinator.md) and binds the three command entries to it with `agent:` and `subagent: false`; without it, no coordinator profile is generated and the commands run in the caller session.

profiles.name: explore
profiles.description: Focused reconnaissance of project or external source for one tightly scoped question.

profiles.name: implement
profiles.description: Implements one small, verifiable implementation slice.

profiles.name: implement-easy
profiles.description: Implements one routine implementation slice (easy-task dispatch context).

profiles.name: implement-hard
profiles.description: Implements one reasoning-heavy implementation slice (hard-task dispatch context).

profiles.name: fix
profiles.description: Addresses only the specified review findings in a fix pass.

profiles.name: review
profiles.description: Independent high-reasoning review of one completed implementation slice.

profiles.name: review-deep
profiles.description: Expensive, integration-level audit of several accepted implementation slices.

profiles.name: consult
profiles.description: Independent second opinion on one stuck technical decision; read-only, returns one recommendation.

profiles.name: consult-hard
profiles.description: Independent second opinion on one reasoning-heavy stuck technical decision; read-only, returns one recommendation.

coordinator.name: coordinator
coordinator.description: Workflow coordinator session: plans bounded slices, dispatches worker children, and integrates their reports.
